version_form: Exact three-part numeric release with optional fixed suffix, or sha256:<64 lowercase hex>; no floating aliases, ranges or wildcards. A trusted producer must verify immutable resolution.

levels.simulation: A rehearsal. It cannot qualify a live action.
levels.code_check: Static or unit checks. They do not prove an engine build or play session.
levels.environment_probe: Actual selected tools, services, model and workspace probes.
levels.engine_build: The named engine/toolchain produced this exact artifact.
levels.runtime_test: An actual runtime executed this exact artifact.
levels.export_check: The exported package was independently opened or run without Cloud credentials.
levels.policy_review: An authorized policy service reviewed this exact requested use.
levels.independent_review: A qualified reviewer approved this exact candidate independently of its producers.
levels.owner_acceptance: The authorized product owner explicitly accepted this exact candidate.

Ready.positive_copy: Ready to start this selected path

Publishable.positive_copy: This version is approved for publication

Sellable.positive_copy: This offer is approved for sale

failure_actions.not_passed: Fix the failed or skipped check and run it again
failure_actions.simulation: Run a real check for this version
failure_actions.wrong_level: Collect the required kind of evidence
failure_actions.wrong_binding: Check the current source and build again
failure_actions.untrusted_issuer: Ask an authorized verifier to check this version
failure_actions.wrong_use: Resolve rights for this requested use
failure_actions.review_identity_missing: Record the reviewer's explicit mode and qualified identity
failure_actions.human_required: Ask the authorized product owner to review
failure_actions.wrong_decision_context: Review the current release or offer again
